about.intro_content: Prof. Hao-Xian Yang is Chief of the Department of Thoracic Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. He is a surgical oncologist specialising in lung cancer, esophageal cancer, mediastinal tumours and chest wall tumours.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Yang trained as a research fellow in the Thoracic Service at Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center (2014–2015) and received robotic thoracic surgery training at the University of Alabama at Birmingham. He is one of the pioneering thoracic surgeons in China for minimally invasive approaches, including robotic surgery, video-assisted thoracic surgery (VATS) and uniportal lung resection for non-small cell lung cancer. He has authored more than 40 peer-reviewed papers and edited a Chinese-language textbook on robotic minimally invasive surgery in thoracic oncology.
